# Retro Hotline

> Retro Hotline is a single-player neon 3D browser FPS with dual weapons, slide kicks, melee combat, stagger-based glory kills, wave survival and an original procedural WebAudio synthwave soundtrack.

Official playable URL: https://retro.oodai.space/
The game interface also uses NEON BAY and Bay Bridge Shooter. This is an independent project.
Desktop keyboard and mouse are the documented inputs. Seeded modular districts and Roguelite build progression are development goals, not confirmed released features. Promotional artwork is concept art, not a gameplay screenshot.

## Project information
